0022600085.text: Both the Atlanta Hawks and Orlando Magic open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular season game, with the Hawks on the road. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (day-to-day, foot fracture, game-time decision), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and has Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Franz Wagner (shoulder soreness), Jase Richardson (back soreness), Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain) and Noah Penda (hamstring) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Atlanta won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series, including a 130-101 regular season win in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Hawks a 45% chance to win.
